title: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse
geometryBasis: Named multipolygon 18237793 with the No. 1 four-corner and No. 2 five-corner shells. Standing dimensions come from Yokohama Port Bureau.
sectionBasis: GSI’s DEM5A supplies the pier and plaza grade. Both buildings have three storeys and nominal width of 22.6 m and height of 17.8 m. No. 1 measures 76 m long and No. 2 measures 149 m.
limitations: The model covers both post-2002 warehouse exteriors. The Japanese national elevation data provide the first-order ground contact.
Window and pier rhythms, local roof partitions and secondary awning details are estimates from the accepted 2003 plaza view. Anonymous earlier photographs were excluded.
The city’s published overall dimensions and present-day mapped outlines establish both volumes. The railway remains, interiors and event installations are outside the exterior scope.
